notes.title: 🎬 New Trailer + Demo Release Date!🎉
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p][/p][h3]We’re happy to share our brand-new trailer and announce the [b]demo release date - September 24![/b] 🎉[/h3][h3]Woohoo![/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="xifKaCY0jyE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We’re finishing the last little tweaks to bring you the best experience we can![/p][p][/p][p]This is our first PC project, and we’re pouring lots of love into it. Every update is a big milestone for us, and your joy is the best reward - it makes all the sleepless nights worth it![/p][p][/p][p]It would mean a lot to hear your thoughts on the trailer and the new location we’re showing![/p][p][/p][p]There’s much more waiting for you in the demo! 🚀[/p][p][/p][p]- The Space Sauce Team[/p]
